notes: Inference correctness validation uses a full-data fitted BN solely for algorithmic equivalence checking; it is not predictive test evaluation.
Joint NLL and missing-evidence evaluation use one stratified 80/20 holdout and are supplementary, not repeated-CV estimates.
Missing-evidence evaluation compares exact BN marginalization with train-statistic imputation on identical test masks.
Paired tests are exploratory because repeated CV runs reuse observations.
